_doc: #1783 P2 THE FAN-OUT BUDGET: a push whose changed paths start more than `budget` per-app ship workflows fails CI (cloud-android-fanout-budget-guard.py), unless the paths that cause it are listed in `allow` with a reason. A path matching an `allow` glob is taken out of the change set before the count, so an allowlisted lib edit cannot hide an unrelated wide change in the same commit. Raising `budget` or adding an `allow` entry is an owner decision: every entry needs a `reason` and a `ticket`; test/fanout-budget-guard.test.sh pins the budget at 5 so a silent raise goes red.
